original_review_records.capability: c13s7-subsec-curl-zero-no-global-potential
original_review_records.verdict: not a separate assessment; local exposition
original_review_records.witness: Expository algorithm or immediately worked calculation, not a separate assessment. Read with its displayed definition/bounds/calculation: Write \alpha=P\,dx+Q\,dy, where P(x,y)=\frac{-y}{x^2+y^2}, \qquad Q(x,y)=\frac{x}{x^2+y^2}. Compute: P_y \amp= \frac{-(x^2+y^2)+2y^2}{(x^2+y^2)^2} \amp= \frac{y^2-x^2}{(x^2+y^2)^2}, and Q_x \amp= \frac{(x^2+y^2)-2x^2}{(x^2+y^2)^2} \amp= \frac{y^2-x^2}{(x^2+y^2)^2}. Thus P_y=Q_x everywhere on D.
